description: Explicit VR Little Endian data sets whose elements carry wrong but valid VRs (DCMTK tparser wrongExplicitVRinDataset). 'default' uses the length field size of the VR written in the file; 'dict_length' uses the size of the dictionary VR. Without dictionary preferences DCMTK reads 'default' and rejects 'dict_length', keeping the written VRs PN, UT, ST, CS, UN and LO.
